title: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim turned 15 on Wed 11 Nov 2026 (released 11 Nov 2011; IGN, GamesRadar, Bethesda). Skyrim Special Edition (PC) is 80% off on Steam India: ₹359 instead of ₹1,799, offer ends 18 November with no time given (Steam store page and appdetails cc=in, checked 00:42 and 00:53 IST 12 Nov 2026; GamesRadar: up to 80% off across platforms); the Anniversary Upgrade is ₹899, not discounted (Steam), and adds Creation Club content (Steam, Bethesda AE FAQ). Bethesda announced The Elder Scrolls VI in 2018, revealed its title Sentinel and logo on 3 Nov 2026 (Inven Global, GamesRadar, IGN) and said before the anniversary it 'will not be sharing anything new on Sentinel for some time' (IGN, GamesRadar); no release date or platforms announced (Inven Global, IGN).
